items.text: Items purchased from livestock vendors now correctly retain ownership, fixing duplication/exploitation issues.
Livestock selling now uses a server‑side RPC instead of client triggers, improving reliability of sales and preventing desync exploits.
Teammates can no longer use the break‑in option to force entry into a teammate’s apartment room.
Fixed a bug where teammates were unable to exit rooms after a server restart, restoring normal door exit behavior.
Critters now transition from the startled state to fleeing when they take damage while startled, making animal reactions more realistic.
Fixed a null‑reference crash caused by destroyed elevator floors during save operations.
Moved the Radtown loot crate farther from the window to stop players from cheating by peeking/shooting from outside.
Repositioned the trainyard power‑grid loot crate and added plywood/collider blockers to close windows and railings, preventing loot‑room exploits.
Sealed gaps in Harbor 1 that allowed shooting into the loot room, closing a major exploit.
Boarded up all windows in Harbor 2 that let players look into or shoot the loot room, further securing loot areas.
Fixed mortar weapon desynchronization when players reconnect or enter network range, ensuring consistent mortar behavior.
Fixed bug that prevented transferring water sources (sinks) between rooms.
Livestock now match player speed when being led, preventing lead breaks.
Fixed floating livestock animals and improved idle performance.
Fixed bull AI rotation issue when target lost during observation.
Added open fence gates to ranch and large barn, improving access to the vendor.
Added step height to crabs to stop cliff glitches and introduced batched raycast for obstacle avoidance, fixing wall glitches and leg speed issues.
Reduced health of frogs to 60 and rabbits to 100 (from 200), making them easier to kill.
Increased frog size by 20% for better visibility.
Fixed frog long first jump and resolved pooled frog stuck in dead animation.
Fixed ladder rotation issues, improving climbing alignment.
Biofuel generators are now silent when idle, removing their background noise.

Livestock vendor inventory and sales overhauled: duplicate Custom SMG entry removed (replaced with Thompson), items are now filtered by game mode so guns no longer appear in Primitive, low‑quality turret offering removed, high‑end sales now include 2‑4 basic BP fragments, Thompson, Custom SMG, Python, and HC Revolver, and wool sales now account for about 75% of total livestock revenue.
Fixed mortar desync when reconnecting or entering network range, preventing weapon synchronization issues.
Corrected crossbow arrow head rotation for bowless crossbows, ensuring arrows fly in the intended direction.
Closed gaps and windows that allowed shooting into the Harbor 1 and Harbor 2 loot rooms.
Fixed bug that let water sources be transferred between rooms (sinks).
Added open fence gates to the ranch and large barn for easier access to the vendor.
Livestock now matches player speed when being led, reducing lead breaks.
Frogs are now 20% larger, have reduced health to 60, and feature a corrected first jump, making them easier to encounter.
Crabs received step‑height, obstacle‑avoidance, and leg‑speed improvements; jellyfish swarms added and water checks batched for better performance.
Bull AI rotation fixed when losing target, per‑frame animation allocation reduced, and floating animal idle performance improved.

Livestock vendor inventory updated: duplicate Custom SMG replaced with Thompson, items filtered by game mode, low‑quality turrets removed, high‑end sales now include BP fragments and weapons, and wool now makes up ~75% of sales.
Biofuel generator is now completely silent while idle, removing its background hum.

2026-09-28.summary:
### Combat
- Fixed mortar desync when reconnecting or entering network range, preventing weapon synchronization issues.
- Corrected crossbow arrow head rotation for bowless crossbows, ensuring arrows fly in the intended direction.

### Map & Loot Rooms
- Closed gaps and windows that allowed shooting into the Harbor 1 and Harbor 2 loot rooms.

### Base Building
- Fixed bug that let water sources be transferred between rooms (sinks).
- Added open fence gates to the ranch and large barn for easier access to the vendor.

### Animals & Wildlife
- Livestock now matches player speed when being led, reducing lead breaks.
- Frogs are now 20% larger, have reduced health to 60, and feature a corrected first jump, making them easier to encounter.
- Crabs received step‑height, obstacle‑avoidance, and leg‑speed improvements; jellyfish swarms added and water checks batched for better performance.
- Bull AI rotation fixed when losing target, per‑frame animation allocation reduced, and floating animal idle performance improved.

### Economy & Vendors
- Livestock vendor inventory updated: duplicate Custom SMG replaced with Thompson, items filtered by game mode, low‑quality turrets removed, high‑end sales now include BP fragments and weapons, and wool now makes up ~75% of sales.

### Audio
- Biofuel generator is now completely silent while idle, removing its background hum.

items.text: Livestock vendor auction now pauses if the wool stack size changes mid‑offer; keep your inventory matching the original size or the sale will time out.
Livestock are now docile in safe zones, and the NPC livestock buyer correctly handles cases where livestock die or flee during conversation.
Animals no longer seek out food; food‑sensing disabled for animals that don’t need it, fixing odd food‑related behavior.
Cows can no longer graze on ice or sand, preventing them from wasting resources on unsuitable terrain.
Animal fence gate durability reduced from 500 HP to 100 HP, making them easier to break.
Country tag now respects streamer mode, hiding the player's country when the setting is enabled.

2026-09-27.summary:
### Livestock & Animals
- Livestock vendor auction now pauses if the wool stack size changes mid‑offer; keep your inventory matching the original size or the sale will time out.
- Livestock are now docile in safe zones, and the NPC livestock buyer correctly handles cases where livestock die or flee during conversation.
- Animals no longer seek out food; food‑sensing disabled for animals that don’t need it, fixing odd food‑related behavior.
- Cows can no longer graze on ice or sand, preventing them from wasting resources on unsuitable terrain.

### Structures
- Animal fence gate durability reduced from 500 HP to 100 HP, making them easier to break.

### UI & Quality of Life
- Country tag now respects streamer mode, hiding the player's country when the setting is enabled.

2026-09-26.summary: No notable player-facing changes were identified in the latest development commits.
